questionText: Radon-222 (an odorless, colorless, radioactive noble gas produced by the radioactive decay of Radium-226 in subterranean granite and soils) poses a major health hazard in poorly ventilated basements because:

options.text: It explodes immediately upon contact with indoor fluorescent lighting

options.text: It turns oxygen into poisonous hydrogen cyanide gas

options.text: It corrodes structural steel rebar inside concrete foundations within 2 hours
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: Its inhaled short-lived alpha-emitting decay daughters (Polonium-218 and Polonium-214) deposit in lung bronchial epithelium, acting as the second leading cause of lung cancer
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Radon Gas Indoor Inhalation Hazard.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Environmental and Natural Resource Economics (Radon Gas Indoor Inhalation Hazard):
Its inhaled short-lived alpha-emitting decay daughters (Polonium-218 and Polonium-214) deposit in lung bronchial epithelium, acting as the second leading cause of lung cancer

Radon is a radioactive noble gas; inhaling its alpha-emitting solid progeny (Po-218, Po-214) causes chronic pulmonary irradiation, ranking second only to tobacco smoking in causing lung cancer.
Hence, Option B is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.

questionText: The 'Half-Life' (t_1/2) of a radioactive isotope (e.g. Cesium-137 with t_1/2 = 30 years, or Plutonium-239 with t_1/2 = 24,100 years) is defined as the time required for:

options.text: The complete elimination of 100% of all radioactivity from the universe
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: The atomic nucleus to double its physical weight
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: The temperature of the isotope to drop to absolute zero
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: Exactly half of the radioactive parent nuclei in a sample to undergo decay into daughter products
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Half-Life Concept in Radioactive Decay.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Half-Life Concept in Radioactive Decay (Environmental and Natural Resource Economics):
Half-life is the characteristic time required for 50% of radioactive atoms to disintegrate. Long-lived isotopes (Pu-239, t1/2 = 24,100 yrs) require geological isolation for millennia.
Hence, Option C is correct.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the fossil fuel in List I with its primary hydrocarbon chemical component in List II:

List I:
(A) Natural Gas
(B) Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)

(D) Biogas

List II:
(I) Methane (CH4, approx. 70–90%)
(II) Propane (C3H8) and Butane (C4H10) compressed under moderate pressure
(III) Methane (CH4) compressed to 200–250 bar pressure for vehicular transport
(IV) Methane (55–70%) mixed with Carbon Dioxide (30–45%) from anaerobic digestion

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

A-I, B-II, C-III, D-IV
